name: Madame Enge
source:
“Rather, I think.”

"Without doing anything and trying to be liked is arrogant."

A genuine Hanabito living in Parterdeame.

With collected female Hanabito’s admiration and respect, she is called [ Madame Enge ]

[from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/106205748442/reine-des-fleurs-side-characters-part-2]cannonette[/url]]
